name: Maxim
notes: The repository ships monkey.jar and framework.jar to push to the device and run through app_process, with configuration files for activity whitelists, blocked widgets and scripted XPath actions; it supports Android 5 to 11.
summary: An Android Monkey stress tester for emulators and real devices that parses on-screen controls through the accessibility service and explores apps with random, DFS or priority-guided strategies.
